title: map the number of job postings by state

querychat_viz_widgets.ggsql:
SELECT location_state AS state, COUNT(*) AS postings
FROM scout_postings
WHERE location_state IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(location_state) <> ''
GROUP BY location_state
ORDER BY postings DESC
VISUALISE state AS y, postings AS x
DRAW bar
PROJECT y, x TO cartesian
LABEL x => 'Number of job postings', y => 'State'
